theme: 教材片語・中高階 750–850 第 25 群

items.colloc: admit in error 承認錯誤 | act in error 錯誤行事
items.distinct: by mistake 無意間犯錯 | incorrectly 不正確地
ex: The invoice was issued in error last week.
這張發票上週開立錯誤。
Our team realized the data was entered in error.
我們團隊意識到資料輸入錯誤。
He apologized for sending the email in error.
他為誤傳郵件而道歉。

items.pos: phr. 在極短時間通知下
items.colloc: at short notice 臨時 | on very short notice 在非常臨時的情況下
items.distinct: at the last minute 在最後一刻 | impromptu 即興的
ex: He had to travel on short notice yesterday.
他昨天臨時被派去出差。
It is difficult to arrange on short notice.
要在短時間通知下安排是很困難的。
They canceled the event on short notice.
他們在很倉促的情況下取消了活動。

items.colloc: in light of facts 鑒於事實 | in light of evidence 考量證據
items.distinct: due to 由於 | considering 考慮到
ex: We revised the budget in light of recent losses.
鑒於近期的損失，我們修改了預算。
In light of the feedback, we updated the policy.
考量到回饋意見，我們更新了政策。
Operations were halted in light of safety concerns.
鑒於安全疑慮，營運作業已暫停。

items.colloc: in line with policy 符合規定 | in line with expectations 符合預期
items.distinct: according to 根據 | consistent with 一致的
ex: The new strategy is in line with company goals.
新策略與公司目標一致。
Expenses are in line with our quarterly projections.
支出符合我們的季度預估。
These changes are in line with local regulations.
這些變動符合當地法規。

items.colloc: something in particular 特定的事物 | mention in particular 特別提到
items.distinct: especially 特別地 | specifically 明確地
ex: Our department, in particular, requires more resources.
我們的部門特別需要更多資源。
There is nothing in particular to worry about.
沒有什麼特別需要擔心的事。
The CEO praised the marketing team in particular.
執行長特別讚揚了行銷團隊。

items.colloc: meet in person 親自見面 | apply in person 親自申請
items.distinct: face-to-face 面對面 | individually 個別地
ex: The director requested to meet the client in person.
總監要求親自會見客戶。
You must submit the documents in person at the office.
你必須親自到辦公室遞交文件。
She will explain the proposal in person tomorrow.
她明天會親自說明這份提案。

items.colloc: use in place of 使用以取代 | acting in place of 代理
items.distinct: instead of 而非 | replace 取代（動詞）
ex: We used digital reports in place of paper copies.
我們使用數位報告來取代紙本。
A temporary manager was hired in place of the director.
一位代理經理被聘用來取代總監。
New software was installed in place of the old system.
新軟體被安裝以取代舊系統。

items.colloc: discuss in private 私下討論 | speak in private 單獨談話
items.distinct: in public 公開地 | behind closed doors 秘密進行
ex: The manager asked to speak with the employee in private.
經理要求與該員工私下談話。
Sensitive topics should be handled in private.
敏感話題應該私下處理。
They finalized the contract terms in private.
他們私下敲定了合約條款。

items.colloc: expert in the field of 該領域專家 | research in the field of 該領域研究
items.distinct: in the area of 在…方面 | within the scope of 在…範圍內
ex: She is a renowned expert in the field of finance.
她是金融領域知名的專家。
We are leading in the field of renewable energy.
我們在再生能源領域處於領先地位。
Advanced training is required in the field of engineering.
工程領域需要進階培訓。

items.colloc: in the process of change 轉型中 | in the process of negotiation 洽談中
items.distinct: underway 進行中 | currently 正在
ex: The company is in the process of moving offices.
公司目前正在搬遷辦公室的過程中。
We are in the process of reviewing all applications.
我們正在審核所有申請案。
The system is in the process of being upgraded.
系統正在進行升級的過程中。

items.colloc: prevent infectious disease 預防傳染病 | spread of infectious disease 傳染病擴散
items.distinct: contagious disease 接觸傳染病 | epidemic 流行病
ex: The hospital specializes in treating infectious diseases.
這間醫院專門治療傳染病。
Strict protocols help prevent the spread of infectious disease.
嚴格的程序有助於預防傳染病擴散。
Public awareness is key to controlling infectious diseases.
大眾意識是控制傳染病的關鍵。

items.pos: phr. 情況原本可能更糟
items.colloc: fortunately it could have been worse 幸運的是原本可能更糟 | think it could have been worse 認為原本可能更糟
items.distinct: the worst is over 最糟的過去了 | worse off 境況更差
ex: Although we lost the contract, it could have been worse.
雖然我們失去了合約，但原本可能更糟。
The delay was frustrating, but it could have been worse.
延誤令人沮喪，但原本可能更糟。
Given the market crash, it could have been worse.
鑒於市場崩盤，情況原本可能更糟。

items.colloc: carry just in case 以防萬一攜帶 | keep a copy just in case 以防萬一留存副本
items.distinct: in case of 若發生... | to be safe 為了安全起見
ex: I kept an extra key just in case I lose mine.
我多留了一把鑰匙，以防萬一我弄丟了。
Please bring the presentation file just in case.
請帶上簡報檔案，以防萬一。
She saved the work frequently just in case of errors.
她頻繁地儲存工作，以防發生錯誤。

items.colloc: call just to make sure 打電話確認 | check just to make sure 檢查確認
items.distinct: to confirm 為了確認 | for verification 為了核實
ex: I am calling just to make sure you received the email.
我打電話是為了確認你有收到郵件。
Please recheck the figures just to make sure.
請再檢查一下數字，以確保無誤。
I asked for a receipt just to make sure.
我索取收據是為了確認一下。

items.colloc: keep up to date with trends 跟上趨勢 | keep up to date with news 更新新聞
items.distinct: stay current 保持時新 | update 更新
ex: Please keep up to date with the schedule.
請隨時更新並留意行程表。
It helps to keep up to date with technology.
隨時掌握科技趨勢很有幫助。
We must keep up to date with new regulations.
我們必須隨時掌握新的法規。

items.colloc: keep on top of work 掌握工作進度 | keep on top of tasks 處理好任務
items.distinct: manage 管理 | stay ahead of 領先
ex: She works hard to keep on top of her schedule.
她努力掌握自己的行程安排。
Our team needs to keep on top of industry changes.
我們團隊需要掌握產業變化。
He manages to keep on top of all his emails.
他設法處理好所有的電子郵件。

items.colloc: find the key to success 尋找成功的關鍵 | essential key to success 成功的必要關鍵
items.distinct: recipe for success 成功秘訣 | secret of success 成功秘密
ex: Customer satisfaction is the key to success.
客戶滿意度是成功的關鍵。
Effective communication is the key to success in business.
有效的溝通是商業成功的關鍵。
Hard work is often cited as the key to success.
努力工作常被視為成功的關鍵。

items.colloc: beside the lamp post 在燈柱旁 | hit a lamp post 撞上燈柱
items.distinct: street light 路燈 | utility pole 電線桿
ex: The office building is right next to the lamp post.
辦公大樓就在那根燈柱旁邊。
Maintenance crews are painting the old lamp posts today.
維修人員今天正在粉刷舊燈柱。
The sign is attached to the lamp post outside.
標誌貼在外面的燈柱上。

items.pos: n. 最新作品；最近的工作
items.colloc: review the latest work 審閱最新作品 | publish latest work 出版最新作品
items.distinct: newest release 最新發布 | recent project 最近專案
ex: Have you seen the architect’s latest work?
你看過那位建築師的最新作品了嗎？
The department is reviewing the intern's latest work.
該部門正在審閱實習生的最新工作成果。
Her latest work will be presented at the conference.
她的最新作品將在會議上發表。

items.colloc: lead to success 導致成功 | lead to a problem 導致問題
items.distinct: cause 導致（動詞）| result in 導致；產生結果
ex: Poor planning often leads to many delays.
計畫不周往往會導致許多延誤。
These actions will lead to better results.
這些行動將會帶來更好的成果。
What led to the decision to resign?
是什麼導致了辭職的決定？
